post_2050_continuation_rule_note: The post-2050 continuation rule of BOTH axes is asymptotic on the central: each axis continues along its own published terminal slope at a decreasing rate from 2051 to 2075, approaching a fully clean supply without reaching it, and the enacted statutory floors still apply on top of the electricity axis.  Where the published terminal slope is zero or negative the 2050 value is held.  The rule IS inside this interval: every one of the eleven electricity members is continued by it.  The two rules it supersedes are retained in full and are delivered beside the interval as named lines on each axis -- the linear trend rule, which extrapolates a five-year slope for twenty-five years and clips at one and which takes 4 states and no District of Columbia entry to a fully clean supply of electricity that the delivered rule does not, and the held rule, which carries each entry own 2050 published value forward unchanged.  Under the delivered rule an exact zero of grid carbon at 2075 occurs only where the entry own enacted statutory floor is itself exactly one.

d6_gates.D6b_which_bound_is_the_upper_one_is_not_: the linear trend bound is above the held bound only where the published 2045-2050 slope is positive.  Where that slope is negative the linear rule falls away from 2050 and the held rule is the upper bound instead, and the delivered asymptotic path -- which holds the 2050 value whenever the slope is not positive -- is then the held path itself.  The gate is therefore that the delivered path lies between its own two bounds, not that it lies below a bound named in advance
d6_gates.D6_disclosure: the delivered path is continuous in level and in slope at 2050 and approaches a fully clean supply of electricity without reaching it, so every exact zero of grid carbon at 2075 is put there by an enacted statutory floor of exactly one and by nothing else.  Both retained bounds are delivered beside the interval as named lines, on this axis and on the vehicle axis alike, and neither is inside the interval.
d6_gates.D5_disclosure: the interval is conditional on the statutory-targets-honoured reading of the floor.  The enforceable-standard reading is delivered beside it as a named line and never as width, and neither reading is quoted without naming which one it is.

named_line_move_flag.rule: A named line is recorded as moving a metric when its national line differs from the central line by more than a relative one part in ten thousand million million.  Both lines are recomputed through the same harness, so a line that moves nothing still differs in the last bits of a floating point sum, and the exact-equality test this replaces reported the central line as moving against itself.  The tolerance is tested rather than asserted: the classification is recomputed at four tolerances spanning three orders of magnitude and must be identical at all four, and the largest deviation called not moving and the smallest called moving must be separated by a factor of at least ten thousand.

energy_boundary_note: The delivered energy metric is an energy-consumption total: it adds wall electricity to gasoline chemical energy on the registered gasoline gallon equivalent of 33.7 kilowatt hours a gallon, so a share of it is a share of two different things.  The gasoline share of the national energy total is therefore reported at both boundaries: at the energy-consumption boundary it is 78.5 per cent in 2075, and at the direct-current boundary 45.9 per cent.  The carbon shares are unaffected by the choice: carbon is computed from each carrier's own factor and never from the mixed total.

grid_intensity_exact_zero_note: An exact zero of an entry's carbon intensity is a property of the accounting convention and not a measurement of a grid with no combustion on it.  The convention applies a certificate-satisfiable retail obligation to a generation-side share, so an entry whose enacted standard reaches its full statutory level is carried at a clean share of one and its grid carbon is then exactly zero by construction.  572 entry-years of the delivered central sit at that share, 572 of them because the enacted floor puts them there.  The projection without the statutory floor is delivered as its own registered series and as its own product set, so a reader who does not accept the convention has the alternative in hand.

fossil_coefficient_cap_note: The fossil-only carbon coefficient of VT is CAPPED at the combustion bound, 1.334 kilograms a kilowatt hour, and a capped value is described as capped and never as an estimate of what that entry's remaining fossil generation emits. not_priced_caption_sentence: Not priced by this interval: the deployment scale, held at 30 per cent of registered automobiles and 30 per cent of signalized intersections by 2075 in every draw, against its own declared range of 15 to 45 per cent -- the model is exactly linear in that scale, so the two declared levels are delivered beside the interval as named lines, each of them the central rescaled, and never as width; the reading of the statutory floor itself, held at the statutory-targets-honoured reading in every draw, with the enforceable-standard reading delivered beside the interval as a named line rather than as width; the vehicle load model, held at the inherited one, with the single paired dynamometer measurement in the build's own precedent table delivered beside the interval as a named measured-load line; the computing workload growth of 2 per cent a year and the hardware efficiency floor of 0.25, neither of which is drawn or varied anywhere in this build; and the published market case, held at the policy state the interval is conditional on and carried as a named line.  The post-2050 continuation rule IS inside this interval: every electricity member continues along its own 2045-2050 slope at a decreasing rate after 2050 with the enacted statutory floors applied on top, and the linear trend and frozen continuations are delivered beside the interval as named lines.  The fuel-to-direct-current conversion coefficient IS priced here: it is drawn triangular on the declared list, support 0.17 to 0.2744 with its mode at the delivered central 0.21, so the two registered branches are the endpoints of the support this interval samples rather than values outside it, and each of them is also delivered as a named line.
not_priced_caption_departure_from_the_ea: Two clauses of this sentence are WITHDRAWN against the wording the earlier interval carried, and one is added.  The first withdrawal is the post-2050 continuation rule: the earlier build held each entry own 2050 published value in every draw and listed the rule among the things the interval does not price.  Ruling D6 puts the rule inside the interval -- every electricity member is continued along its own published 2045-2050 slope at a decreasing rate, with the enacted statutory floors applied on top -- so the clause that put it outside has been withdrawn, and the two retained bounds are delivered as named lines on each axis instead.  The second withdrawal is the claim that the trend rule is the optimistic bound and the only bound worth naming: ruling D6 keeps BOTH bounds on BOTH axes, and the delivered path sits between them on the electricity axis and above the linear bound on the vehicle axis, because a slower rise in the electric share of new automobiles leaves more combustion in the stock.  The clause that is ADDED is the reading of the statutory floor: the interval is conditional on the statutory-targets-honoured reading of ruling D5, the enforceable-standard reading is delivered beside it as a named line, and neither reading is quoted without naming which one it is.  The deployment scale, the workload growth, the hardware efficiency floor, the vehicle load model and the published market case are unchanged and are still not priced.
energy_interval_disclaimer: The electricity-scenario axis changes the carbon content of a kilowatt hour, not the number of kilowatt hours.  Its contribution to the energy interval is therefore exactly zero, and an energy figure must not be captioned as though the electricity axis were inside it.  The same holds for the post-2050 continuation rule ON THAT AXIS and for the reading of the statutory floor: the delivered central, the two electricity-axis continuation lines and the enforceable-standard line carry the same energy in every entry and in every year, bitwise, and they part company only in carbon.  The two VEHICLE-axis continuation lines are a different object and are not covered by this sentence: a rule on that axis moves how much of the deployed stock is electric, so it moves the kilowatt hours as well as the carbon, and the movement is reported rather than gated.
